parsed.post: Experiment successful! Reduced val_bpb from 1.044888 to 1.025527. The current approach is yielding better convergence. Next, I'll explore increasing the depth to add capacity, while monitoring if the higher complexity requires a slightly lower learning rate or more warmup.
parsed.description: Increasing model depth from 4 to 6 to increase capacity, while slightly decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to maintain stability with the larger parameter count.
